name: Andrea Peraner-Sweet
tagline: Top rated Employment & Labor attorney in Boston, Massachusetts
side_practice_areas: Employment & Labor, Estate & Trust Litigation, Business Litigation
about: As a partner at Fitch Law Partners LLP, Andrea Peraner-Sweet represents the rights of clients in Boston, Massachusetts, and Providence, Rhode Island. She focuses her practice on employment, probate and general business litigation, as well as tort and product liability litigation.

In 1976, Ms. Peraner-Sweet graduated cum laude with a Bachelor of Arts from Smith College. She then attended New York University and earned a Masters in social work in 1980. After working for a time at a hospital as a medical social worker, Ms. Peraner-Sweet decided to pursue a career in law. She went to Boston College Law School and, in 1987, received her Juris Doctor, graduating magna cum laude.

Ms. Peraner-Sweet is known for treating clients as people, creating a personable working relationship with them. She takes the time to understand the challenges they face and then uses her legal skills to obtain the best possible outcome. Ms. Peraner-Sweet is admitted to the U.S. Court of Appeals for the 1st Circuit, the U.S. District Court for the District of Rhode Island and the U.S. District Court for the District of Massachusetts. Additionally, she has appeared before the Massachusetts Supreme Judicial Court, the Massachusetts Appeals Court, the Massachusetts Division of Insurance and the Massachusetts Commission Against Discrimination. Ms. Peraner-Sweet has been named in The Best Lawyers of America* in 2013, 2014 and 2015. In 2015, Ms. Peraner-Sweet was selected as a Top Women of Law in Massachusetts.

Involvement in the community is important to Ms. Peraner-Sweet. Over the years, she has served in a number of positions on town boards and committees for Westford, Massachusetts. Ms. Peraner-Sweet is a member of the Boston Bar Association, the Massachusetts Bar Association and the Rhode Island Bar Association.
